## Vendored: hidapi (inside libtransport.so)

The vendored transport binaries export hidapi symbols (`hid_init`, `hid_enumerate`, `hid_read_timeout`, `hid_version_str`, …) and contain the object file `hid.c`. `hid_version_str` in `libtransport.so` is **0.15.0**. This is **not** a Cargo dependency; VioDeck never calls hidapi itself. The vendor library embeds hidapi and is bundled as described above.

hidapi 0.15.0 is tri-licensed (GPL-3.0, BSD-style, or original HIDAPI). The BSD-style and original notices are reproduced below. Whether MiraboxSpace compiled hidapi under GPL-3.0 remains an open legal question (`docs/legal/TODO.md`).

## Vendored: Liberation Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

- Location: `k1pro-app/fonts/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` and `LiberationSans-Bold.ttf`
- How bundled: `include_bytes!` into the VioDeck binary for in-memory SVG `<text>` rasterization (`usvg` / `resvg`). Also copied into packaged builds as `licenses/LICENSE-LiberationSans.txt`. Not installed as a system font and not served over the network.
- Copyright: Digitized data copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation with Reserved Font Arimo, Tinos and Cousine. Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc. with Reserved Font Name Liberation.

```

for deterministic SVG <text> rasterization. These files are loaded
only via include_bytes into usvg's in-memory font database.
They are not scanned from the host, not served as web assets, and
```

## Brand SVG / Inter outlines

VioDeck wordmark SVG paths in `k1pro-app/icons/viodeck-assets/` were produced from locally available Inter outlines. Inter font files are **not** redistributed. Inter is SIL OFL 1.1 (The Inter Project Authors). UI CSS refers to Inter and Space Grotesk as family names and uses system fallbacks; those font files are not shipped.
